**Chinese name:** 北京华大九天科技股份有限公司 (Běijīng Huádà Jiǔtiān Kējì Gǔfèn Yǒuxiàn Gōngsī)

::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Founded May 2009; China's largest domestic EDA software vendor, positioned to benefit directly as US export controls restrict Chinese chip designers' access to foreign EDA tools (Synopsys, Cadence, Siemens EDA). H1 2026 revenue reached ¥566 million (+13.0% YoY) but the company posted a net loss of ¥45.06 million for the half; analyst forecasts cited in domestic coverage project a return to profitability by full-year 2026 (roughly ¥40 million net profit), rising toward ¥180 million by 2028 as revenue growth continues at a projected ~20%/year.
:::

## What does this firm design?

EDA software tools used by chip designers for layout, verification, and simulation — the software layer that every other fabless firm in this tracker depends on.
